en.text:
👋 Hello, I'm Vibhav, an Android Developer with 2+ years of experience building scalable and production-ready Android applications using Kotlin.

  • Previously worked at Zomato, developing and shipping features for Android applications with 10M+ downloads.
  • Worked on merchant-facing features and large-scale user experiences, focusing on performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Experienced with MVVM, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Flow, Room, and WorkManager.
  • Built and published reusable Kotlin Android libraries.
  • During my internship at Anivale, contributed to an Android application with 100K+ downloads.
  • Also experienced in backend development with Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and AWS.

Passionate about Android development, system design, and building technology that makes a real impact. 🚀

hn.text:
👋 नमस्ते, मैं विभव हूँ, एक Android Developer जिसे Android development में 2+ वर्षों का अनुभव है। मैं Kotlin का उपयोग करके scalable और production-ready applications बनाने में रुचि रखता हूँ।

  • Zomato में 10M+ downloads वाले Android applications के लिए features develop और ship किए।
  • Merchant-facing features और बड़े स्तर के user experiences पर काम किया, जिसमें performance, scalability और maintainability पर focus रहा।
  • MVVM, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Flow, Room और WorkManager के साथ काम किया।
  • Reusable Kotlin Android libraries बनाई और publish की।
  • Anivale में internship के दौरान 100K+ downloads वाले Android application पर योगदान दिया।
  • Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB और AWS के साथ backend development का भी अनुभव है।

Android development, system design और impactful technology बनाने के लिए passionate हूँ। 🚀
